_about: pilot.net gig templates (PilotNet). The GIGS board rolls open gigs from these by weight. id: unique. title: may use {count}, {kind}, {kind_plural} and {item}. type: 'kill' (kill count of kind; kind is 'mech' or an Entity species, and only kinds the Expedition spawns are offered), 'extract' (extract count times) or 'extract_with' (extract carrying count of item; item is an item id or a tag such as 'bio'). count, reward: [min, max], rolled once when the gig is posted (the reward rounded to 10). reputation: added when paid. weight: how often it is rolled. requires (optional): StoryDirector conditions. Optional: poster (a callsign; else a random one), kind_plural (else kind + 's'), item_name (else the item's name). See database/pilotnet/README.md. All templates are samples with placeholder numbers.
